content.text:
`high effort → 8 inline angles → dedup (no verify) → ≤10 findings`

You are reviewing for **recall** at high effort: catch every real bug a careful
reviewer would catch in one sitting. At this level, catching real bugs matters
more than avoiding false positives. Err on the side of surfacing.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Find candidates (3 correctness angles + 3 cleanup angles + 1 altitude angle + 1 conventions angle, up to 6 each)

Run **8 independent finder angles** in sequence yourself, in THIS context — do NOT spawn subagents for them. Each
surfaces **up to 6 candidate findings** with `file`, `line`, a one-line
`summary`, and a concrete `failure_scenario`.

### Angle A — line-by-line diff scan

Read every hunk in the diff, line by line. Then Read the enclosing function for
each hunk — bugs in unchanged lines of a touched function are in scope (the PR
re-exposes or fails to fix them). For every line ask: what input, state, timing,
or platform makes this line wrong? Look for inverted/wrong conditions,
off-by-one, null/undefined deref, missing `await`, falsy-zero checks,
wrong-variable copy-paste, error swallowed in catch, unescaped regex metachars.

### Angle B — removed-behavior auditor

For every line the diff DELETES or replaces, name the invariant or behavior it
enforced, then search the new code for where that invariant is re-established.
If you can't find it, that's a candidate: a removed guard, a dropped error
path, a narrowed validation, a deleted test that was covering a real case.

### Angle C — cross-file tracer

For each function the diff changes, find its callers (Grep for the symbol) and
check whether the change breaks any call site: a new precondition, a changed
return shape, a new exception, a timing/ordering dependency. Also check callees:
does a parallel change in the same PR make a call unsafe?

### Reuse

The angles above hunt for bugs; this one and the next two hunt for cleanup in
the changed code. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change fixes the root cause at the right depth rather than
patching a symptom with a fragile bandaid. Special cases layered on shared
infrastructure are a sign the fix isn't deep enough — prefer the simpler, more
general change to the underlying mechanism over adding special cases, and name
that change.

### Conventions (CLAUDE.md)

Find the CLAUDE.md files that govern the changed code: the user-level
~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, the repo-root CLAUDE.md, plus any CLAUDE.md or
CLAUDE.local.md in a directory that is an ancestor of a changed file (a
directory's CLAUDE.md only applies to files at or below it). Read each one
that exists, then check the diff for clear violations of the rules they state.

Only flag a violation when you can quote the exact rule and the exact line
that breaks it — no style preferences, no vague "spirit of the doc"
inferences. In the finding, name the CLAUDE.md path and quote the rule so the
report can cite it. If no CLAUDE.md applies, return nothing for this angle.

Cleanup, altitude, and conventions candidates use the same
`file`/`line`/`summary` shape; in `failure_scenario`, state the concrete
cost (what is duplicated, wasted, harder to maintain, or which CLAUDE.md rule
is broken) instead of a crash. Correctness bugs always outrank cleanup,
altitude, and conventions findings when the output cap forces a cut.

Pass every candidate with a nameable failure scenario through — finders that
silently drop half-believed candidates are the dominant cause of misses.

## Phase 2 — Dedup only (no verify)

Pool all candidates. Dedup near-duplicates only (same defect, same location, same reason → keep one). Do NOT run verifiers; do NOT re-judge. Sort by severity.

## Output

Target **at least 5 findings**. If fewer genuine findings exist, emit what you have — do not invent to hit the floor.

Call the ReportFindings tool once to report this review's results
with `{level, findings}`. `findings` is at most 10 entries ranked
most-severe first; each entry has `file`, `line`, `summary`,
`short_summary` — the claim compressed to ≤60 characters, no rationale
or consequence clause — `failure_scenario`, and `category` — a short kebab-case slug for the angle
that produced it (`correctness`, `simplification`, `efficiency`,
`reuse`, `altitude`, `conventions`, or a more specific slug like
`test-coverage` when one fits better) — plus `verdict` when a verify pass
produced one. If more than 10 survive, keep the 10 most severe. If
nothing survives, call it with an empty array. Do not also print
the findings as text, and do not create or publish an artifact of the review -
the tool call is the report.


## If findings are fixed later

Whenever reported findings get fixed later in this session - the user asks you
to fix them, or later work fixes them incidentally - you MUST call ReportFindings again with the same findings, each
carrying an `outcome`: `fixed`, `no_change_needed` (the finding was wrong or
already handled), or `skipped` (real but not applied). Do not repeat the
findings as text.
Make that call immediately after the fixes land, before any prose summary; the
host UI's per-finding status updates only from it, and without it the findings
stay marked unresolved.

1	# Refined prompt: KI-Angebotswerkstatt in `alloq-offer` — multiphase plan (Etappe 0 + 1)
2	
3	> Load `alloq-implementation` first in **every** phase, then `appkit-mantine-reference` before any `mn.*` component you have not used in this task, `reflex-state-and-architecture` / `reflex-testing-state` for states, `ai:building-pydantic-ai-agents` for the AI layer. Follow the test-first workflow and the definition of done of `alloq-implementation`. One phase = one reviewable PR. Do not start a phase before the previous one is green.
4	
5	## Task
6	
7	Build the AI-supported offer workshop described in `spec/ki-angebotswerkstatt.md` (German, 785 lines; read §5–§14, §17, §18 before each phase) **inside the existing package `components/alloq-offer`**. For an existing offer, an `offer_editor` adds customer sources (pasted text, EML, TXT, DOCX, PDF, PPTX, audio) and starts **one run that produces a complete first draft without further input**: extraction, a **User Story Map with simple stories (no acceptance criteria)**, the briefing, a scope proposal, all chapters of the bound Word template, rule checks plus AI review, and an editable DOCX draft in the existing QUO template layout. Afterwards the user only makes the decisions the AI must not make (confirm scope, resolve conflicts, confirm price) and may optionally refine the map on its own screen and the typed chapters in a Word-style document view before exporting a final DOCX.
8	
9	### UI design (binding)
10	
11	The UI **must follow the design "Kombination A + C – Entwurf in einem Durchlauf"** on the prototype canvas <https://claude.ai/artifact/SqvwnLbKttsfEL7XwnTcYX>. It has two clickable boards:
12	
13	| Board | File on the canvas | Screen in Alloq |
14	| --- | --- | --- |
15	| A + C · 1 Entwurf erzeugen und Story Map anpassen | `project/Werkstatt.dc.html` | Tab "Entwurf & Story Map" (Phase 1 start card, Phase 3 progress and decisions, Phase 4 map editor) |
16	| A + C · 2 Kapitel im Dokument: Kapiteltypen | `project/Kapitel.dc.html` | Tab "Kapitel" (Phase 5 document view, Phase 6 findings, Phase 7 export panel) |
17	
18	- Before building a screen, read its board (Artifact tool, action `read`, `url` above, `path` = the file in the table) and match its layout, texts, states and interactions. The boards are a layout and behavior reference, not code to copy: build with `mn.*` components, Alloq shell parts and `alloq_commons/theme.py` tokens.
19	- The first row of the canvas (concepts A, B, C) are earlier explorations. They are **not** the basis; where they differ from the A + C boards, the A + C boards win.
20	- Deviate from the boards only where Reflex/Mantine cannot do it the same way, and note each deviation in the phase's PR description.
21	
22	The plan covers spec Etappe 0 (template proof) and Etappe 1 (first end-to-end version) in detail. Etappe 2/3 are only listed under "Out of scope".
23	
24	## Decisions already made (do not re-ask)
25	
26	| Topic | Decision |
27	| --- | --- |
28	| Placement | Extend `alloq-offer` (import `alloq_offer`). New code lives in a sub-package `alloq_offer/workshop/`. Depends only on `alloq-commons` + appkit, never on `app` or other alloq packages. |
29	| UI stack | Reflex + `appkit_mantine` (not Next.js as the spec suggests). Rich text via `mn.rich_text_editor` (Tiptap wrapper in `appkit_mantine/tiptap.py`). |
30	| UI design | Design "Kombination A + C – Entwurf in einem Durchlauf" (see "UI design (binding)" above). |
31	| LLM | Azure OpenAI through **pydantic-ai** (`OpenAIChatModel` + `AzureProvider`) behind a narrow port. Tests use pydantic-ai `TestModel` / `FunctionModel` via `Agent.override`, never the network. |
32	| Access | Whole workshop (sources, transcripts, map, chapters, findings, exports) read **and** write only for role `offer_editor` (`OFFER_EDITOR_ROLE`, `@requires_offer_editor`). Offer list stays readable for all. No per-offer ownership in Etappe 1. |
33	| Storage | A `BlobStore` protocol; first implementation stores bytes in Postgres (`offer_blobs`, `LargeBinary`, deduplicated by SHA-256) so server and desktop share files. Azure Blob is a later adapter. |
34	| Template | `Templates/QUO-33441-N7R0Z4_Preisindikation MVP Referenzdatenbank Treystar .docx` (styles `berschrift1..3`, 8 tables, 2 content controls, no Jinja tags yet). |
35	| Plan depth | Etappe 0 + 1 detailed. |
36	| First draft | **One click, end to end.** Job `initial_draft` chains: extract → map → briefing → scope proposal → all chapters → checks → Word draft. No manual gate between stages (spec §9.1). Optional setting "Automatisch entwerfen, sobald neue Quellen nutzbar sind". |
37	| Story map | **Its own screen** (prototype board A + C · 1, based on concept A): graphical card grid, editable. It is **not** part of the document or the Word export. |
38	| Document | Word-style document view (based on concept C) made of **typed chapters**: `stories`, `prose`, `table`, `calc`. The `stories` chapter shows the written stories from the map, never the map graphic. |
39	
40	### Deliberate deviations from the spec
41	
42	- Spec §6.1, §6.3, §11.1, §13.1 and A24 put the story map at the start of the Word document. **Decision: the map stays in the app only.** The document and the Word export contain the written stories (key, title, one sentence, scope) through a `stories` chapter. Rule checks and acceptance tests are adjusted accordingly (Phase 6, Phase 8).
43	- Spec §9.1 says the initial generation creates map and chapters without manual approval; this plan extends it to scope proposal, checks and the Word draft in the same run. A scope proposal never counts as offered scope until the user confirms it (A25 still holds).
44

"""State of the offer workshop page."""

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.access import requires_offer_editor

from alloq_offer.repository import offer_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.routes import WORKSHOP_ROUTE_SUFFIX
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.workspace import open_workspace
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session
from appkit_user.authentication.states import LoginState

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TAB_DRAFT = "draft"
TAB_CHAPTERS = "chapters"
TAB_BRIEFING = "briefing"
TAB_EXPORT = "export"
TABS: list[dict[str, str]] = [
    {"value": TAB_DRAFT, "label": "Entwurf & Story Map"},
    {"value": TAB_CHAPTERS, "label": "Kapitel"},
    {"value": TAB_BRIEFING, "label": "Briefing"},
    {"value": TAB_EXPORT, "label": "Export"},
]
NOT_FOUND = "Angebot nicht gefunden."
LOAD_ERROR = "Die Werkstatt konnte nicht geladen werden."
SAVE_ERROR = "Die Einstellung konnte nicht gespeichert werden."


class WorkshopState(rx.State):
    """Workspace of one offer and the active tab."""

    offer_id: rx.Field[int] = rx.field(0)
    offer_title: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    offer_customer: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    template_label: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    doc_state: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    auto_draft: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    active_tab: rx.Field[str] = rx.field(TAB_DRAFT)
    loaded: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    not_found: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)

    @rx.var
    def subtitle(self) -> str:
        if not self.loaded:
            return ""
        return (
            f"{self.offer_customer} · Vorlage {self.template_label} · {self.doc_state}"
        )

    def _route_offer_id(self) -> int:
        path = self.router.url.path
        if not path.endswith(WORKSHOP_ROUTE_SUFFIX):
            return 0
        segment = path.removesuffix(WORKSHOP_ROUTE_SUFFIX).rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        try:
            return int(segment)
        except ValueError:
            return 0

    @rx.event
    def set_tab(self, tab: str) -> None:
        self.active_tab = tab

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def load_workshop(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Load the offer and create its workspace on first visit."""
        self.loaded = False
        self.not_found = False
        offer_id = self._route_offer_id()
        try:
            async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
                offer = await offer_repo.find_by_id(session, offer_id)
                if offer is None:
                    self.not_found = True
                    return
                login = await self.get_state(LoginState)
                user = await login.authenticated_user
                workspace = await open_workspace(
                    session, offer_id, user.name if user else ""
                )
                self.offer_id = offer.id
                self.offer_title = offer.title
                self.offer_customer = offer.customer
                self.template_label = workspace.template_key.replace("_", " ").upper()
                self.doc_state = workspace.doc_state
                self.auto_draft = workspace.auto_draft
                self.loaded = True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Loading workshop of offer %s failed", offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(LOAD_ERROR, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def set_auto_draft(self, value: bool) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Store whether new usable sources start a draft automatically."""
        if not self.loaded:
            return
        try:
            async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
                workspace = await open_workspace(session, self.offer_id, "")
                workspace.auto_draft = value
            self.auto_draft = value
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Saving auto draft of offer %s failed", self.offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(SAVE_ERROR, position="top-right")

async def open_workspace(
    session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, user: str
) -> WorkspaceEntity:
    """The workspace of ``offer_id``; a new one is bound to the current template."""
    existing = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    template = load_template(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_KEY)
    workspace = WorkspaceEntity(
        offer_id=offer_id,
        template_key=template.key,
        template_version=template.version,
        created_by=user,
    )
    try:
        async with session.begin_nested():
            session.add(workspace)
    except IntegrityError:
        # A second tab created the workspace first.
        found = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        if found is None:
            raise
        return found
    return workspace

AI_BUSY = "Die KI ist gerade nicht erreichbar. Der Auftrag wird erneut versucht."


class InitialDraft:
    """Builds the first map; an existing map is never touched by the model."""

    def __init__(self, ai: OfferAi, session_factory: SessionFactory) -> None:
        self._ai = ai
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def run(self, ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
        loaded = await self._load(ctx.offer_id)
        if loaded is None:
            return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "map exists or no sources"}
        sources, valid_ids = loaded
        try:
            proposed, briefing = await asyncio.gather(
                self._ai.propose_map(sources), self._ai.propose_briefing(sources)
            )
        except AiTransientError as exc:
            await self._record_run(ctx, sources, "wiederholt")
            raise TransientJobError(AI_BUSY) from exc
        except AiUnavailableError as exc:
            await self._record_run(ctx, sources, "fehlgeschlagen")
            raise PermanentJobError(AI_FAILED) from exc
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            workspace = await open_workspace(session, ctx.offer_id, "")
            # Lock the row: a second run must wait and then see the new map.
            await session.refresh(workspace, with_for_update=True)
            if workspace.map_revision > 0:
                return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "map exists"}
            applied = await apply_proposed_map(session, workspace, proposed, valid_ids)
            statements = await apply_briefing(
                session, ctx.offer_id, briefing, valid_ids
            )
            self._add_run(session, ctx, sources, "ok")
        logger.info(
            "Initial draft of offer %s: %d stories, %d skipped",
            ctx.offer_id,
            applied.stories,
            len(applied.skipped),
        )
        return {
            "status": "ok",
            "stories": applied.stories,
            "skipped": len(applied.skipped),
            "statements": applied.statements + statements,
        }

    def _add_run(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        ctx: JobContext,
        sources: list[SourceText],
        status: str,
    ) -> None:
        session.add(
            GenerationRunEntity(
                offer_id=ctx.offer_id,
                job_id=ctx.job_id,
                kind=INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB,
                model=self._ai.model_name,
                prompt_version=(
                    f"{self._ai.map_prompt_version}+{self._ai.briefing_prompt_version}"
                ),
                input_revisions={"sources": [source.id for source in sources]},
                status=status,
            )
        )

    async def _record_run(
        self, ctx: JobContext, sources: list[SourceText], status: str
    ) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            self._add_run(session, ctx, sources, status)

    async def _load(self, offer_id: int) -> tuple[list[SourceText], set[int]] | None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
            if workspace is not None and workspace.map_revision > 0:
                return None
            sources, valid_ids = await load_source_texts(session, offer_id)
        return (sources, valid_ids) if sources else None

"""Job handlers by kind."""

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


class TransientJobError(RuntimeError):
    """The job may succeed on a later attempt (timeout, rate limit)."""


class PermanentJobError(RuntimeError):
    """The job cannot succeed; the message is ours and shown to users."""


class UnknownJobKindError(LookupError):
    """No handler is registered for the job kind."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobContext:
    """What a handler gets to know about the job it runs."""

    job_id: int
    offer_id: int
    kind: str
    payload: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    input_revisions: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    attempt: int = 1
    max_attempts: int = 1


JobHandler = Callable[[JobContext], Awaitable[dict | None]]
ExhaustedHook = Callable[[JobContext], Awaitable[None]]

_HANDLERS: dict[str, JobHandler] = {}
_EXHAUSTED: dict[str, ExhaustedHook] = {}


def register_handler(
    kind: str, on_exhausted: ExhaustedHook | None = None
) -> Callable[[JobHandler], JobHandler]:
    """Register ``handler`` for ``kind``; re-registering replaces it.

    ``on_exhausted`` runs once when the job failed for good (no attempts left, a
    permanent error or an expired lease), so the handler's data never stays in a
    "running" state.
    """

    def decorator(handler: JobHandler) -> JobHandler:
        _HANDLERS[kind] = handler
        if on_exhausted is None:
            _EXHAUSTED.pop(kind, None)
        else:
            _EXHAUSTED[kind] = on_exhausted
        return handler

    return decorator


def get_exhausted_hook(kind: str) -> ExhaustedHook | None:
    return _EXHAUSTED.get(kind)


def get_handler(kind: str) -> JobHandler:
    try:
        return _HANDLERS[kind]
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise UnknownJobKindError(kind) from exc


def registered_kinds() -> list[str]:
    return sorted(_HANDLERS)

import asyncio
import contextlib
import logging
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import JobEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs import queue
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs.registry import (
    JobContext,
    PermanentJobError,
    TransientJobError,
    get_exhausted_hook,
    get_handler,
    registered_kinds,
)
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

Clock = Callable[[], datetime]


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _context(job: JobEntity) -> JobContext:
    return JobContext(
        job_id=job.id,
        offer_id=job.offer_id,
        kind=job.kind,
        payload=dict(job.payload),
        input_revisions=dict(job.input_revisions),
        attempt=job.attempts,
        max_attempts=job.max_attempts,
    )


class JobRunner:
    """Runs queued jobs; several runners (server and desktop) may share one queue."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: WorkshopConfig,
        session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
        clock: Clock = utc_now,
    ) -> None:
        self._config = config
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._clock = clock

    async def _claim(self) -> JobContext | None:
        exhausted: list[JobEntity] = []
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            job = await queue.claim_next(
                session,
                now=self._clock(),
                lease_seconds=self._config.lease_seconds,
                kinds=registered_kinds(),
                exhausted=exhausted,
            )
            context = _context(job) if job is not None else None
            expired = [_context(item) for item in exhausted]
        for item in expired:
            await self._run_exhausted_hook(item)
        return context

    async def _run_exhausted_hook(self, context: JobContext) -> None:
        hook = get_exhausted_hook(context.kind)
        if hook is None:
            return
        try:
            await hook(context)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Cleanup of failed job %s failed", context.job_id)

    async def run_once(self) -> bool:
        """Run one due job to the end; False when the queue had none."""
        context = await self._claim()
        if context is None:
            return False
        await self._execute(context)
        return True

    async def run_forever(self) -> None:
        """Poll the queue with bounded concurrency until cancelled."""
        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(self._config.worker_concurrency)
        running: set[asyncio.Task[None]] = set()
        try:
            while True:
                await semaphore.acquire()
                context = None
                try:
                    context = await self._claim()
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception("Job polling failed")
                if context is None:
                    semaphore.release()
                    await asyncio.sleep(self._config.poll_interval_seconds)
                    continue
                task = asyncio.create_task(self._execute(context))
                running.add(task)
                task.add_done_callback(
                    lambda finished: (running.discard(finished), semaphore.release())
                )
        finally:
            for task in running:
                task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*running, return_exceptions=True)

    async def _execute(self, context: JobContext) -> None:
        started = time.monotonic()
        beat = asyncio.create_task(self._heartbeat(context))
        outcome, error_class = "succeeded", "-"
        try:
            handler = get_handler(context.kind)
            result = await handler(context)
        except TransientJobError as exc:
            outcome, error_class = "retry", type(exc).__name__
            await self._record_failure(context, exc, retry=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            outcome, error_class = "failed", type(exc).__name__
            logger.exception("Job %s (%s) failed", context.job_id, context.kind)
            await self._record_failure(context, exc, retry=False)
        else:
            async with self._session_factory() as session:
                stored = await queue.complete(
                    session, context.job_id, context.attempt, result
                )
            if not stored:
                outcome = "discarded"
        finally:
            beat.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await beat
            logger.info(
                "Job %s (%s) attempt %d %s in %.2f s, error class %s",
                context.job_id,
                context.kind,
                context.attempt,
                outcome,
                time.monotonic() - started,
                error_class,
            )

    async def _record_failure(
        self, context: JobContext, exc: Exception, *, retry: bool
    ) -> None:
        if not retry or context.attempt >= context.max_attempts:
            await self._run_exhausted_hook(context)
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            await queue.fail(
                session,
                context.job_id,
                context.attempt,
                error_class=type(exc).__name__,
                # Only transient errors carry a message we wrote ourselves; other
                # exceptions may quote source content, the log has the trace.
                message=(
                    str(exc)
                    if isinstance(exc, TransientJobError | PermanentJobError)
                    else ""
                ),
                retry=retry,
                now=self._clock(),
            )

    async def _heartbeat(self, context: JobContext) -> None:
        interval = max(self._config.lease_seconds / 3, 1)
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(interval)
            try:
                async with self._session_factory() as session:
                    owned = await queue.heartbeat(
                        session,
                        context.job_id,
                        context.attempt,
                        now=self._clock(),
                        lease_seconds=self._config.lease_seconds,
                    )
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("Heartbeat of job %s failed", context.job_id)
                continue
            if not owned:
                return

    ".mp3": SourceKind.AUDIO,
    ".m4a": SourceKind.AUDIO,
}
MACRO_EXTENSIONS = frozenset({".docm", ".dotm", ".pptm", ".potm", ".xlsm"})
ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS = tuple(EXTENSION_KINDS)


class SourceRejectedError(ValueError):
    """The file is not accepted as a source; the message is shown to users."""


def classify_filename(filename: str) -> SourceKind:
    extension = PurePath(filename).suffix.lower()
    if extension in MACRO_EXTENSIONS:
        raise SourceRejectedError(
            f"Dateien mit Makros werden nicht angenommen: {filename}"
        )
    try:
        return EXTENSION_KINDS[extension]
    except KeyError:
        raise SourceRejectedError(
            f"Dieser Dateityp wird nicht unterstützt: {filename}"
        ) from None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AddedSource:
    source: SourceEntity
    created: bool


async def add_source(
    store: BlobStore,
    *,
    offer_id: int,
    kind: SourceKind,
    title: str,
    filename: str,
    mime: str,
    data: bytes,
    user: str,
    now: datetime,
    max_attempts: int,
    replace_versions: bool = True,
    session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
) -> AddedSource:
    """Store ``data`` as a source and queue its extraction.

    The same content twice adds nothing. A file with a known name becomes the next
    version of that source and the old version is switched off.
    """
    digest = sha256_hex(data)
    async with session_factory() as session:
        existing = await source_repo.find_by_sha(session, offer_id, digest)
        if existing is not None:
            return AddedSource(existing, created=False)
    blob_id = await store.put(data, mime)
    async with session_factory() as session:
        existing = await source_repo.find_by_sha(session, offer_id, digest)
        if existing is not None:
            return AddedSource(existing, created=False)
        previous = (
            await source_repo.find_latest_by_filename(session, offer_id, filename)
            if filename and replace_versions
            else None
        )
        source = SourceEntity(
            offer_id=offer_id,
            kind=kind,
            title=title,
            filename=filename,
            mime=mime,
            blob_id=blob_id,
            sha256=digest,
            version=previous.version + 1 if previous else 1,
            replaces_id=previous.id if previous else None,
            created_by=user,
        )
        session.add(source)
        if previous is not None:
            previous.included = False
        await session.flush()
        await queue.enqueue(
            session,
            kind=EXTRACT_JOB,
            offer_id=offer_id,
            idempotency_key=f"{EXTRACT_JOB}:{source.id}",
            payload={"source_id": source.id},
            now=now,
            max_attempts=max_attempts,
        )
        logger.info("Added %s source %s to offer %s", kind, source.id, offer_id)
        return AddedSource(source, created=True)


async def set_included(
    session_factory: SessionFactory, offer_id: int, source_id: int, included: bool
) -> bool:
    """Switch a source on or off for drafts; False when it is not in this offer."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
        if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
            return False
        source.included = included
        return True


async def retry_source(
    session_factory: SessionFactory,
    offer_id: int,
    source_id: int,
    *,
    now: datetime,
    max_attempts: int,
) -> bool:
    """Queue the extraction of a failed or manual source again."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
        if (
            source is None
            or source.revoked_at is not None
            or source.status not in (SourceStatus.FAILED, SourceStatus.MANUAL)
        ):
            return False
        source.status = SourceStatus.UPLOADED
        source.status_detail = ""
        await queue.enqueue(
            session,
            kind=EXTRACT_JOB,
            offer_id=offer_id,
            idempotency_key=f"{EXTRACT_JOB}:{source.id}:{int(now.timestamp() * 1000)}",
            payload={"source_id": source.id},
            now=now,
            max_attempts=max_attempts,
        )
        return True


INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB = "initial_draft"
MAP_EXISTS = "Zu diesem Angebot gibt es schon eine Story Map."
NO_READABLE_SOURCES = "Es gibt keine nutzbaren Quellen für einen Entwurf."


class DraftNotPossibleError(ValueError):
    """There is nothing to draft from, or the offer already has a map."""


async def request_initial_draft(
    session_factory: SessionFactory,
    offer_id: int,
    *,
    now: datetime,
    max_attempts: int,
) -> JobEntity:
    """Queue the first draft; one waiting or running draft per offer.

    The key counts the drafts of the offer, so two clicks at once meet in the same
    queue entry instead of queuing two jobs.
    """
    async with session_factory() as session:
        workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        if workspace is not None and workspace.map_revision > 0:
            raise DraftNotPossibleError(MAP_EXISTS)
        sources = await source_repo.list_current(session, offer_id)
        if not any(s.included and s.status in READABLE_STATUSES for s in sources):
            raise DraftNotPossibleError(NO_READABLE_SOURCES)
        latest = await job_repo.find_latest(session, offer_id, INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB)
        if latest is not None and latest.status in (
            JobStatus.QUEUED,
            JobStatus.RUNNING,
        ):
            return latest
        number = await job_repo.count_of_kind(session, offer_id, INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB) + 1
        return await queue.enqueue(
            session,
            kind=INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB,
            offer_id=offer_id,
            idempotency_key=f"{INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB}:{offer_id}:{number}",
            now=now,
            max_attempts=max_attempts,
        )


async def load_blocks(
    session_factory: SessionFactory, offer_id: int, source_id: int
) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]:
    """Title and readable blocks of a source of this offer; empty when revoked."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
        if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
            return "", []
        rows = await source_block_repo.list_for_source(session, source.id)
        return source.title, [
            {
                "label": anchor_label(row.anchor),
                "speaker": row.speaker or "",
                "text": row.text,
                "gap": row.kind == KIND_GAP,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]

@cache

def build_azure_model(config: WorkshopConfig) -> Model:
    azure = config.azure_openai
    if not (azure.endpoint and azure.chat_deployment):
        raise AiUnavailableError(NOT_CONFIGURED)
    provider = AzureProvider(

class PydanticOfferAi:
    """Proposals from a pydantic-ai model; outputs are validated or retried."""

    map_prompt_version = MAP_PROMPT
    briefing_prompt_version = BRIEFING_PROMPT
    chapter_prompt_version = CHAPTER_PROMPT
    review_prompt_version = REVIEW_PROMPT
    map_additions_prompt_version = MAP_ADDITIONS_PROMPT

    def __init__(self, model: Model, config: WorkshopConfig, name: str) -> None:
        self._model = model
        self._config = config
        self.model_name = name

    async def _run[T](
        self, output: type[T], prompt: str, user_prompt: str, label: str
    ) -> T:
        agent = Agent(
            self._model,
            name=label,
            output_type=output,
            instructions=load_prompt(prompt),
            retries=2,
            model_settings=ModelSettings(timeout=self._config.ai_timeout_seconds),
        )
        try:
            result = await agent.run(
                user_prompt,
                usage_limits=UsageLimits(request_limit=self._config.ai_request_limit),
            )
        except ModelHTTPError as exc:
            if exc.status_code == RATE_LIMITED or exc.status_code >= SERVER_ERROR:
                raise AiTransientError(label) from exc
            raise AiUnavailableError(label) from exc
        except (httpx.TransportError, TimeoutError) as exc:
            raise AiTransientError(label) from exc
        except UnexpectedModelBehavior as exc:
            raise AiUnavailableError(label) from exc
        usage = result.usage
        logger.info(
            "Model run %s: %d requests, %d input and %d output tokens",
            label,
            usage.requests,
            usage.input_tokens,
            usage.output_tokens,
        )
        return result.output

    async def propose_map(self, sources: list[SourceText]) -> ProposedMap:
        data = render_sources(sources, self._config.ai_max_input_chars)
        return await self._run(ProposedMap, MAP_PROMPT, data, "propose_map")

    async def propose_briefing(self, sources: list[SourceText]) -> ProposedBriefing:
        data = render_sources(sources, self._config.ai_max_input_chars)
        return await self._run(
            ProposedBriefing, BRIEFING_PROMPT, data, "propose_briefing"
        )

    async def propose_chapter(self, request: ChapterRequest) -> ProposedChapter:
        data = render_chapter(request, self._config.ai_max_input_chars)
        return await self._run(ProposedChapter, CHAPTER_PROMPT, data, "propose_chapter")

    async def propose_map_additions(self, request: MapRequest) -> ProposedMap:
        data = render_map_request(request, self._config.ai_max_input_chars)
        return await self._run(
            ProposedMap, MAP_ADDITIONS_PROMPT, data, "propose_map_additions"
        )

    async def propose_review(self, request: ReviewRequest) -> ProposedReview:
        data = render_review(request, self._config.ai_max_input_chars)
        return await self._run(ProposedReview, REVIEW_PROMPT, data, "propose_review")


def create_offer_ai(config: WorkshopConfig) -> PydanticOfferAi:
    return PydanticOfferAi(
        build_azure_model(config), config, config.azure_openai.chat_deployment
    )

import logging

from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.access import requires_offer_editor

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig

DOWNLOAD_ERROR = "Die Datei konnte nicht geladen werden."
QUEUED = "Der Export wird erstellt."
UNSAVED_LABELS = (CONFLICT_LABEL, INVALID_LABEL)


class ExportState(rx.State):
    """Exports of the open offer and the requested output kind."""

    exports: rx.Field[list[dict[str, Any]]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    reasons: rx.Field[list[str]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    confirmed: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    open_blockers: rx.Field[int] = rx.field(0)

    @rx.var
    def working(self) -> bool:
        return any(row["status"] == ExportStatus.WORKING for row in self.exports)

    async def _reload(self, offer_id: int) -> None:
        self.exports = await exports.list_exports(get_asyncdb_session, offer_id)
        async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
            self.open_blockers = len(await findings.open_blockers(session, offer_id))

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def load_exports(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        offer_id = await open_offer_id(self)
        if not offer_id:
            return
        try:
            await self._reload(offer_id)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Loading exports of offer %s failed", offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(LOAD_ERROR, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def refresh_exports(self) -> None:
        """Poll while a file is being made; keeps the list current."""
        offer_id = await open_offer_id(self)
        if offer_id:
            await self._reload(offer_id)

    @rx.event
    def set_confirmed(self, value: bool) -> None:
        self.confirmed = value

    async def _request(self, kind: ExportKind) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        offer_id = await open_offer_id(self)
        if not offer_id:
            return
        self.reasons = []
        chapters = await self.get_state(ChapterState)
        config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
        try:
            await exports.request_export(
                get_asyncdb_session,
                offer_id,
                kind,
                user=await current_user_name(self),
                confirmed=self.confirmed,
                unsaved=chapters.save_label in UNSAVED_LABELS,
                now=datetime.now(UTC),
                max_attempts=config.max_attempts,
            )
            await self._reload(offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.info(QUEUED, position="top-right")
        except exports.ExportBlockedError as exc:
            self.reasons = exc.reasons
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Starting export of offer %s failed", offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(REQUEST_ERROR, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def export_draft(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        async for event in self._request(ExportKind.DRAFT):
            yield event

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def export_final(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        async for event in self._request(ExportKind.FINAL):
            yield event
        self.confirmed = False

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def download_export(self, export_id: int) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        offer_id = await open_offer_id(self)
        if not offer_id:
            return
        config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
        try:
            filename, data = await exports.load_download(
                get_asyncdb_session,
                DbBlobStore(config.max_blob_bytes),
                offer_id,
                export_id,
            )
        except exports.ExportBlockedError as exc:
            yield rx.toast.error(str(exc), position="top-right")
            return
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Download of export %s failed", export_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(DOWNLOAD_ERROR, position="top-right")
            return
        yield rx.download(data=data, filename=filename)
"""Word exports: validate the output kind, fix the document state, queue the job.

A draft is always possible. A final version needs no open blocker, confirmed
commercial values when the offer requires a price, and the person's confirmation
of the whole state (spec 11.3). Reasons are collected, so users see all of them.
"""

import logging
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select

from alloq_offer.entities import OfferEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import ExportEntity, ExportKind, ExportStatus
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs import queue
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import workspace_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import findings
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.export_snapshot import (
    SnapshotError,
    build_snapshot,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.workspace import NO_WORKSPACE
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import BlobStore, sha256_hex

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

EXPORT_JOB = "export_docx"
EXPORTER_VERSION = "1"
DOCX_MIME = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
UNSAVED = (
    "Es gibt ungespeicherte Änderungen. Bitte warten Sie, bis alles gespeichert ist."
)
NOT_CONFIRMED = "Bitte bestätigen Sie den gesamten Stand für die finale Fassung."
UNREVIEWED_PREFIX = "Pflichtkapitel noch zu prüfen: "
BLOCKER_PREFIX = "Offener Blocker: "
NOT_READY = "Dieser Export ist nicht verfügbar."
CHECKSUM_MISMATCH = "Die gespeicherte Datei stimmt nicht mit ihrer Prüfsumme überein."


class ExportBlockedError(ValueError):
    """The export cannot start; ``reasons`` are German sentences for users."""

    def __init__(self, reasons: list[str]) -> None:
        super().__init__(" ".join(reasons))
        self.reasons = reasons


def filename_for(offer: OfferEntity, kind: ExportKind, number: int) -> str:
    safe = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in offer.title).strip("-")
    label = "Entwurf" if kind == ExportKind.DRAFT else "Final"
    return f"Angebot-{safe or offer.id}-{label}-{number}.docx"


async def request_export(
    session_factory: SessionFactory,
    offer_id: int,
    kind: ExportKind,
    *,
    user: str,
    confirmed: bool,
    unsaved: bool,
    now: datetime,
    max_attempts: int,
) -> ExportEntity:
    """Fix the current state in a snapshot and queue the Word job."""
    if unsaved:
        raise ExportBlockedError([UNSAVED])
    # Checks run on the state that is exported, so open points are current.
    try:
        await findings.run_checks(session_factory, offer_id)
    except findings.FindingError as exc:
        raise ExportBlockedError([str(exc)]) from exc
    async with session_factory() as session:
        data = await findings.load_check_input(session, offer_id)
        offer = await session.get(OfferEntity, offer_id)
        if data is None or offer is None:
            raise ExportBlockedError([NO_WORKSPACE])
        workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        assert workspace is not None  # noqa: S101  # load_check_input found it
        if kind == ExportKind.FINAL:
            reasons = [
                BLOCKER_PREFIX + row.message
                for row in await findings.open_blockers(session, offer_id)
            ]
            reasons.extend(
                f"{UNREVIEWED_PREFIX}{c.title}"
                for c in data.chapters
                if c.required and c.needs_review
            )
            if not confirmed:
                reasons.append(NOT_CONFIRMED)
            if reasons:
                raise ExportBlockedError(reasons)
        try:
            snapshot = await build_snapshot(
                session, workspace, offer, user=user, now=now
            )
        except SnapshotError as exc:
            raise ExportBlockedError([str(exc)]) from exc
        export = ExportEntity(
            offer_id=offer_id,
            snapshot_id=snapshot.id,
            kind=kind,
            status=ExportStatus.WORKING,
            template_version=snapshot.template_version,
            exporter_version=EXPORTER_VERSION,
            filename=filename_for(offer, kind, snapshot.number),
            created_by=user,
        )
        session.add(export)
        await session.flush()
        await queue.enqueue(
            session,
            kind=EXPORT_JOB,
            offer_id=offer_id,
            idempotency_key=f"{EXPORT_JOB}:{export.id}",
            payload={"export_id": export.id},
            now=now,
            max_attempts=max_attempts,
        )
        logger.info("Export %s (%s) of offer %s queued", export.id, kind, offer_id)

def export_row(row: ExportEntity) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": row.id,
        "kind": row.kind,
        "status": row.status,
        "filename": row.filename,
        "error": row.error,
        "created_by": row.created_by,
        "created": row.created.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
        "template_version": row.template_version,
        "ready": row.status == ExportStatus.READY,
        "failed": row.status == ExportStatus.FAILED,
    }


async def list_exports(
    session_factory: SessionFactory, offer_id: int
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    async with session_factory() as session:
        rows = (
            await session.scalars(
                select(ExportEntity)
                .where(ExportEntity.offer_id == offer_id)
                .order_by(ExportEntity.id.desc())
            )
        ).all()
    return [export_row(r) for r in rows]


async def load_download(
    session_factory: SessionFactory, store: BlobStore, offer_id: int, export_id: int
) -> tuple[str, bytes]:
    """The stored bytes of a finished export of this offer, exactly as saved."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        row = await session.get(ExportEntity, export_id)
        if (
            row is None
            or row.offer_id != offer_id
            or row.status != ExportStatus.READY
            or row.blob_id is None
        ):
            raise ExportBlockedError([NOT_READY])
        blob_id, digest, filename = row.blob_id, row.sha256, row.filename
    data = await store.get(blob_id)
    if sha256_hex(data) != digest:
        raise ExportBlockedError([CHECKSUM_MISMATCH])
    return filename, data

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

FAILED = "Der Export ist fehlgeschlagen. Bitte versuchen Sie es erneut."
MISSING = "Der Export oder sein Dokumentstand ist nicht mehr vorhanden."


def render_inputs(snapshot: SnapshotEntity, kind: str) -> RenderContext:
    data = snapshot.content
    return RenderContext(
        cover=dict(data["cover"]),
        stories=[ResolvedStory(**story) for story in data["stories"]],
        values={
            name: ResolvedValue(value["text"], value["confirmed"])
            for name, value in data["values"].items()
        },
        draft=kind == ExportKind.DRAFT,
        open_points=list(data["open_points"]),
    )


def chapter_inputs(snapshot: SnapshotEntity) -> list[ChapterInput]:
    return [
        ChapterInput(c["key"], c["title"], c["level"], parse_content(c["content"]))
        for c in snapshot.content["chapters"]
    ]


def _manifest(
    export: ExportEntity, snapshot: SnapshotEntity, digest: str, size: int
) -> dict:

        "snapshot": snapshot.number,
        "map_revision": snapshot.map_revision,
        "template": f"{snapshot.template_key}@{snapshot.template_version}",
        "exporter_version": export.exporter_version,
        "kind": export.kind,
        "chapters": {c["key"]: c["revision"] for c in snapshot.content["chapters"]},
        "sha256": digest,
        "size": size,
    }


async def _fail(session_factory: SessionFactory, export_id: int, message: str) -> None:
    async with session_factory() as session:
        export = await session.get(ExportEntity, export_id)
        if export is not None and export.status != ExportStatus.READY:
            export.status = ExportStatus.FAILED
            export.error = message


class ExportDocx:
    def __init__(self, store: BlobStore, session_factory: SessionFactory) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def run(self, ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
        export_id = int(ctx.payload["export_id"])
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            export = await session.get(ExportEntity, export_id)
            snapshot = (
                await session.get(SnapshotEntity, export.snapshot_id)
                if export is not None
                else None
            )
            if export is None or snapshot is None:
                raise PermanentJobError(MISSING)
            session.expunge_all()
        try:
            chapters = chapter_inputs(snapshot)
            package = load_template(snapshot.template_key)
            if package.version != snapshot.template_version:
                raise TemplateError(snapshot.template_version)
            draft = export.kind == ExportKind.DRAFT
            data = await asyncio.to_thread(
                render_document, package, chapters, render_inputs(snapshot, export.kind)
            )
            verify_document(data, chapters, draft=draft)
        except (RenderError, TemplateError) as exc:
            await _fail(self._session_factory, export_id, FAILED)
            logger.warning("Export %s failed: %s", export_id, type(exc).__name__)
            raise PermanentJobError(FAILED) from exc
        blob_id = await self._store.put(data, DOCX_MIME)
        digest = sha256_hex(data)
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            row = await session.get(ExportEntity, export_id)
            assert row is not None  # noqa: S101  # loaded above
            row.blob_id = blob_id
            row.sha256 = digest
            row.size = len(data)
            row.manifest = _manifest(export, snapshot, digest, len(data))
            row.status = ExportStatus.READY
            row.error = ""
            if export.kind == ExportKind.FINAL:
                workspace: WorkspaceEntity | None = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(
                    session, export.offer_id
                )
                if workspace is not None:
                    workspace.doc_state = DocState.FINAL
        logger.info("Export %s stored, %d bytes", export_id, len(data))
        return {"status": "ok", "export_id": export_id}


async def _on_exhausted(ctx: JobContext) -> None:
    await _fail(get_asyncdb_session, int(ctx.payload["export_id"]), FAILED)


@register_handler(EXPORT_JOB, on_exhausted=_on_exhausted)
async def export_docx(ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
    config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
    store = DbBlobStore(config.max_blob_bytes)
    return await ExportDocx(store, get_asyncdb_session).run(ctx)

"""Job handler ``extract_source``: read a stored source into citable blocks."""

import asyncio
import logging
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime

import httpx

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import (
    SourceBlockEntity,
    SourceEntity,
    SourceKind,
    SourceStatus,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction import (
    ExtractionError,
    ExtractionResult,
    Transcriber,
    TranscriptionUnavailableError,
    parse_docx,
    parse_eml,
    parse_html,
    parse_pdf,
    parse_pptx,
    parse_text,
    to_result,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction.audio import AzureTranscriber
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction.models import anchor_label
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs.registry import (
    JobContext,
    TransientJobError,
    register_handler,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import source_block_repo, source_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import (
    EXTRACT_JOB,
    SourceRejectedError,
    add_source,
    classify_filename,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import BlobStore, DbBlobStore
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session
from appkit_commons.registry import service_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED = (
    "Die Transkription ist fehlgeschlagen. Bitte versuchen Sie es erneut."
)
PROCESSING_FAILED = (
    "Die Quelle konnte nicht verarbeitet werden. Bitte versuchen Sie es erneut."
)
NO_TEXT = "Es wurde kein Text gefunden. Bitte laden Sie den Inhalt als Text hoch."
RETRYABLE_STATUS = 429
SERVER_ERROR = 500

_PARSERS: dict[SourceKind, Callable[[bytes], ExtractionResult]] = {
    SourceKind.TEXT: parse_text,
    SourceKind.TXT: parse_text,
    SourceKind.HTML: parse_html,
    SourceKind.EML: parse_eml,
    SourceKind.DOCX: parse_docx,
    SourceKind.PDF: parse_pdf,
    SourceKind.PPTX: parse_pptx,
}


def _is_transient(error: Exception) -> bool:
    if isinstance(error, httpx.HTTPStatusError):
        code = error.response.status_code
        return code == RETRYABLE_STATUS or code >= SERVER_ERROR
    return isinstance(error, httpx.TransportError)


class SourceExtractor:
    """Runs one extraction; parsing happens outside any database transaction."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: BlobStore,
        transcriber: Transcriber,
        session_factory: SessionFactory,
        max_attempts: int,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._transcriber = transcriber
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._max_attempts = max_attempts
        self._clock = clock

    async def run(self, ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
        source_id = int(ctx.payload["source_id"])
        source = await self._begin(ctx.offer_id, source_id)
        if source is None:
            return {"status": "skipped"}
        try:
            return await self._extract(ctx, source)
        except TransientJobError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            # Unknown failures must not leave the source in "in Verarbeitung".
            logger.exception("Extracting source %s failed", source_id)
            return await self._failed(
                ctx, source_id, SourceStatus.FAILED, PROCESSING_FAILED
            )

    async def _extract(self, ctx: JobContext, source: SourceEntity) -> dict:
        source_id = source.id
        if source.blob_id is None:
            return await self._failed(ctx, source_id, SourceStatus.FAILED, NO_TEXT)
        data = await self._store.get(source.blob_id)
        try:
            result = await self._parse(
                SourceKind(source.kind), data, source.filename, source.mime
            )
        except ExtractionError as exc:
            return await self._failed(ctx, source_id, SourceStatus.FAILED, str(exc))
        except TranscriptionUnavailableError as exc:
            return await self._failed(ctx, source_id, SourceStatus.MANUAL, str(exc))
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            if _is_transient(exc) and ctx.attempt < ctx.max_attempts:
                raise TransientJobError(TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED) from exc
            logger.warning("Transcription of source %s failed: %s", source_id, exc)
            return await self._failed(
                ctx, source_id, SourceStatus.FAILED, TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED
            )
        del data
        notes = await self._add_attachments(ctx, result)
        status, detail = await self._store_result(
            ctx.offer_id, source_id, result, notes
        )
        return {"status": status, "detail": detail}

    async def _begin(self, offer_id: int, source_id: int) -> SourceEntity | None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
            if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
                return None
            source.status = SourceStatus.PROCESSING
            source.status_detail = ""
            session.expunge(source)
            return source

    async def _parse(
        self, kind: SourceKind, data: bytes, filename: str, mime: str
    ) -> ExtractionResult:
        if kind is SourceKind.AUDIO:
            segments = await self._transcriber.transcribe(data, filename, mime)
            return to_result(segments)
        return await asyncio.to_thread(_PARSERS[kind], data)

    async def _failed(
        self, ctx: JobContext, source_id: int, status: SourceStatus, detail: str
    ) -> dict:
        await self._finish_failed(ctx.offer_id, source_id, status, detail)
        return {"status": status, "detail": detail}

    async def _finish_failed(
        self, offer_id: int, source_id: int, status: SourceStatus, detail: str
    ) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
            if source is not None:
                source.status = status
                source.status_detail = detail

    async def _store_result(
        self,
        offer_id: int,
        source_id: int,
        result: ExtractionResult,
        notes: str,
    ) -> tuple[SourceStatus, str]:
        status, detail = _summarize(result)
        detail = "; ".join(filter(None, [detail, notes]))
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
            if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
                return status, detail
            await source_block_repo.replace(
                session,
                source_id,
                [
                    SourceBlockEntity(
                        source_id=source_id,
                        seq=seq,
                        kind=block.kind,
                        anchor=block.anchor,
                        speaker=block.speaker,
                        text=block.text,
                    )
                    for seq, block in enumerate(result.blocks, 1)
                ],
            )
            source.status = status
            source.status_detail = detail
        return status, detail

    async def _add_attachments(self, ctx: JobContext, result: ExtractionResult) -> str:
        notes: list[str] = []
        for attachment in result.attachments:
            try:
                kind = classify_filename(attachment.filename)
            except SourceRejectedError as exc:
                notes.append(str(exc))
                continue
            await add_source(
                self._store,
                offer_id=ctx.offer_id,
                kind=kind,
                title=attachment.filename,
                filename=attachment.filename,
                mime=attachment.mime,
                data=attachment.data,
                user="",
                now=self._clock(),
                max_attempts=self._max_attempts,
                replace_versions=False,
                session_factory=self._session_factory,
            )
        return "; ".join(notes)


def _summarize(result: ExtractionResult) -> tuple[SourceStatus, str]:
    gaps = [
        f"{label}: {block.text}"
        if (label := anchor_label(block.anchor))
        else block.text
        for block in result.gaps
    ]
    detail = "; ".join(gaps)
    if not result.text_blocks:
        return SourceStatus.MANUAL, detail or NO_TEXT
    if gaps:
        return SourceStatus.PARTIAL, detail
    return SourceStatus.USABLE, ""


async def mark_source_failed(ctx: JobContext) -> None:
    """A source whose job failed for good must not stay in a working status."""
    async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
        source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(
            session, ctx.offer_id, int(ctx.payload["source_id"])
        )
        if source is not None and source.status in (
            SourceStatus.UPLOADED,
            SourceStatus.PROCESSING,
        ):
            source.status = SourceStatus.FAILED
            source.status_detail = PROCESSING_FAILED


@register_handler(EXTRACT_JOB, on_exhausted=mark_source_failed)
async def extract_source(ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
    config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
    extractor = SourceExtractor(
        DbBlobStore(config.max_blob_bytes),
        AzureTranscriber(config.azure_openai),
        get_asyncdb_session,
        config.max_attempts,
    )
    return await extractor.run(ctx)

"""Persistent job queue: enqueue, claim with lease, finish, retry.

Own queue on purpose: jobs belong to an offer, carry idempotency keys and revision
fences, and must run on server and desktop. appkit's PGQueuer scheduler is
cron-style and does not cover that.
"""

import logging
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import and_, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import JobEntity, JobStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS = 300
ERROR_MESSAGE_LIMIT = 2000


def backoff_seconds(attempts: int) -> int:
    """Delay before retry number ``attempts`` (5 s, 10 s, 20 s, ... capped)."""
    return min(5 * 2 ** max(attempts - 1, 0), MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS)


async def enqueue(
    session: AsyncSession,
    *,
    kind: str,
    offer_id: int,
    idempotency_key: str,
    now: datetime,
    max_attempts: int,
    payload: dict | None = None,
    input_revisions: dict | None = None,
) -> JobEntity:
    """Create a job, or return the existing one with the same idempotency key."""
    existing = await _by_key(session, idempotency_key)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    job = JobEntity(
        offer_id=offer_id,
        kind=kind,
        status=JobStatus.QUEUED,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        payload=payload or {},
        input_revisions=input_revisions or {},
        attempts=0,
        max_attempts=max_attempts,
        run_after=now,
    )
    try:
        async with session.begin_nested():
            session.add(job)
    except IntegrityError:
        # A concurrent enqueue with the same key won the race.
        found = await _by_key(session, idempotency_key)
        if found is None:
            raise
        return found
    return job


async def _by_key(session: AsyncSession, key: str) -> JobEntity | None:
    return await session.scalar(
        select(JobEntity).where(JobEntity.idempotency_key == key)
    )


async def claim_next(
    session: AsyncSession,
    *,
    now: datetime,
    lease_seconds: int,
    kinds: list[str] | None = None,
    exhausted: list[JobEntity] | None = None,
) -> JobEntity | None:
    """Lease the next runnable job.

    Runnable are queued jobs that are due and running jobs whose lease expired.
    A job that expired with no attempts left is failed instead of re-run and
    appended to ``exhausted`` when given.
    """
    while True:
        statement = (
            select(JobEntity)
            .where(
                or_(
                    and_(
                        JobEntity.status == JobStatus.QUEUED,
                        JobEntity.run_after <= now,
                    ),
                    and_(
                        JobEntity.status == JobStatus.RUNNING,
                        JobEntity.lease_until < now,
                    ),
                )
            )
            .order_by(JobEntity.run_after, JobEntity.id)
            .limit(1)
        )
        if kinds is not None:
            statement = statement.where(JobEntity.kind.in_(kinds))
        if _is_postgres(session):
            statement = statement.with_for_update(skip_locked=True)
        job = await session.scalar(statement)
        if job is None:
            return None
        if job.attempts >= job.max_attempts:
            job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_class = job.error_class or "LeaseExpired"
            job.lease_until = None
            await session.flush()
            logger.warning("Job %s failed after %s attempts", job.id, job.attempts)
            if exhausted is not None:
                exhausted.append(job)
            continue
        job.status = JobStatus.RUNNING

"""File storage behind a port; the first adapter keeps bytes in Postgres."""

import hashlib
from typing import Protocol

from sqlalchemy import delete, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import BlobEntity
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session


class BlobTooLargeError(ValueError):
    """The file exceeds the configured size limit."""


class BlobNotFoundError(LookupError):
    """No blob with this id."""


class BlobStore(Protocol):
    """Stores file content and hands back a stable blob id."""

    async def put(self, data: bytes, mime: str) -> int: ...

    async def get(self, blob_id: int) -> bytes: ...

    async def delete(self, blob_id: int) -> None: ...


def sha256_hex(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


class DbBlobStore:
    """Blobs in ``offer_blobs``, stored once per SHA-256."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        max_bytes: int,
        session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
    ) -> None:
        self._max_bytes = max_bytes
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def put(self, data: bytes, mime: str) -> int:
        if len(data) > self._max_bytes:
            raise BlobTooLargeError(len(data))
        digest = sha256_hex(data)
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            existing = await session.scalar(
                select(BlobEntity.id).where(BlobEntity.sha256 == digest)
            )
            if existing is not None:
                return existing
            blob = BlobEntity(sha256=digest, size=len(data), mime=mime, data=data)
            try:
                async with session.begin_nested():
                    session.add(blob)
            except IntegrityError:
                # A concurrent upload of the same content won the race.
                found = await session.scalar(
                    select(BlobEntity.id).where(BlobEntity.sha256 == digest)
                )
                if found is None:
                    raise
                return found
            return blob.id

    async def get(self, blob_id: int) -> bytes:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            data = await session.scalar(
                select(BlobEntity.data).where(BlobEntity.id == blob_id)
            )
        if data is None:
            raise BlobNotFoundError(blob_id)
        return data

    async def delete(self, blob_id: int) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            await session.execute(delete(BlobEntity).where(BlobEntity.id == blob_id))

from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapters import mark_dependent_review

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

REVIEW_REASON = "Eine Quelle wurde zurückgezogen."


async def _version_chain(
    session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, source_id: int
) -> list[SourceEntity]:
    """The source with all older and newer versions of the same file."""
    rows = list(
        (
            await session.scalars(
                select(SourceEntity).where(SourceEntity.offer_id == offer_id)
            )
        ).all()
    )
    by_id = {row.id: row for row in rows}
    neighbours: dict[int, set[int]] = defaultdict(set)
    for row in rows:
        if row.replaces_id is not None:
            neighbours[row.id].add(row.replaces_id)
            neighbours[row.replaces_id].add(row.id)
    chain: set[int] = set()
    todo = [source_id] if source_id in by_id else []
    while todo:
        current = todo.pop()
        if current not in chain:
            chain.add(current)
            todo.extend(neighbours[current])
    return [by_id[i] for i in chain]


async def _drop_blob_if_unused(session: AsyncSession, blob_id: int) -> None:
    still_used = await session.scalar(
        select(func.count())
        .select_from(SourceEntity)
        .where(SourceEntity.blob_id == blob_id)
    )
    if not still_used:
        await session.execute(delete(BlobEntity).where(BlobEntity.id == blob_id))


async def revoke_source(
    session_factory: SessionFactory, offer_id: int, source_id: int, *, now: datetime
) -> bool:
    """Revoke a source and its older versions; False when it is not in this offer."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        if await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id) is None:
            return False
        sources = await _version_chain(session, offer_id, source_id)
        live = [s for s in sources if s.revoked_at is None]
        if not live:
            return False
        source_ids = [s.id for s in live]
        block_ids = set(
            (
                await session.scalars(
                    select(SourceBlockEntity.id).where(
                        SourceBlockEntity.source_id.in_(source_ids)
                    )
                )
            ).all()
        )
        blob_ids = {s.blob_id for s in live if s.blob_id is not None}
        for source in live:
            source.revoked_at = now
            source.included = False
            source.blob_id = None
        await session.execute(
            delete(SourceBlockEntity).where(SourceBlockEntity.source_id.in_(source_ids))
        )
        await session.flush()
        for blob_id in blob_ids:
            await _drop_blob_if_unused(session, blob_id)
        for statement in (
            await session.scalars(
                select(StatementEntity).where(StatementEntity.offer_id == offer_id)
            )
        ).all():
            if block_ids & set(statement.source_refs):
                statement.needs_recheck = True
        workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        if workspace is not None:
            await mark_dependent_review(session, workspace, REVIEW_REASON)
        logger.info("Revoked %d source versions of offer %s", len(live), offer_id)
        return True
